summary: Upgrade the operator by changing the subscription channel to stable-2.6 (from 2.4 or 2.5), previewing and approving the InstallPlan, then creating an AAP CR; skip 2.5 from 2.4, migrate auth from 2.5 first, put controller and hub in one namespace, back up first, and EDA 2.4 upgrades aren't supported.
questions: How do I upgrade the AAP Operator to 2.6?
Should I upgrade from 2.4 to 2.5 or straight to 2.6?
Must controller and hub be in the same namespace before upgrading to 2.6?
Can I upgrade EDA 2.4 on OpenShift?

answer_card.title: Upgrade the AAP Operator to 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
Before: back up (AutomationControllerBackup, AutomationHubBackup, EDABackup); controller and hub in one namespace; from 2.4 go straight to 2.6; from 2.5 migrate auth first. EDA 2.4 upgrades are unsupported.

1. Installed Operators > AAP > *Subscriptions*.
2. Channel `stable-2.6`.
3. Preview InstallPlan > Approve.
4. Create an AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR.
